text:
elaine: FYI we got a large prospect (FISCALBANK) asking for a fully air-gapped POC. They need: upgrade cadence, signed bundle provenance, rollback plan, pricing for sealed envs + SLA. Can SE/Eng + Legal weigh in?

jonah: +1. Do we have a minimal deliverable list for them? typically we provide: bootstrap image, offline agent bundle (tar.gz), signed SBOM, install runbook, and a delta/patch cadence. Also need licensing activation flow for offline installs.

marco: For packaging: prefer layered bundles — base runtime + model artifacts + delta patches. We ship signed deltas to avoid full re-provision. Suggested cadence: monthly critical patches (signed deltas), quarterly feature rollouts. If customer wants weekly security patches we can do but charge for expedited signing and delivery.

priya: Pricing Q: are you expecting per-node committed capacity or usage-based? For Dedicated/offline we usually do a reserved-node model + an offline support addon. Need their expected GPU count and support tier to quote.

marcus-legal: Legal checklist: we require a signed On-Prem Addendum, export control review (models may trigger restrictions), and agreement on tamper-evidence requirements for bundle signing. Also confirm whether the customer will manage KMS/HSM or we provide appliance.

jonah: Ops/technical notes: verification snippet we give customers to validate bundles locally:
```
cosign verify-blob --signature redwood.sig redwood-offline-2026-03.tar.gz
sha256sum redwood-offline-2026-03.tar.gz | grep ^abc123
```
We also include a signed SBOM and the GPG public key in the delivery manifest.

deploy-bot: package-builder: completed redwood-offline-2026-03.tar.gz sha256=abc123def4567890abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789
(sig=redwood-202603.sig)

annah-ops: Rollback constraints: DB migrations must be avoidable in POC init. If migrations are required they need an offline migration plan and backup snapshot. Recommended acceptance test: smoke -> perf (token/sec) -> canary restore window 30m. Rollback procedure: redeploy previous bundle + invalidate KV cache, restart agent. Document these as step-by-step in runbook.

marco: Note on quantized models: model artifacts are large; delta patching only effective for runtime and small parameter tweaks. For model replacements we still usually deliver full bundles unless using chunked model overlay. That affects cadence and cost.

priya: For SOW we typically list: delivery package (signed), 1 on-site or remote install assist, 30 days of post-install support, 24/7 escalation add-on. If they want patching service we add recurring maintenance fee.

marcus-legal: Also confirm audit/logging requirements. We need to enable audit export and preserve for X days per contract. SAML/SCIM integration notes — if they want SSO in air-gapped env we need a connector and cert exchange process documented.

elaine: Good thread. Action items: @jonah prepare POC deliverable checklist & verification commands by EOD Thu. @priya draft commercial sketch (committed nodes + maintenance) for initial 6-month term. @marcus-legal list required contract clauses and export checklist. @annah-ops create rollback runbook draft and acceptance tests. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with the customer for next Tue.

jonah: sounds good. I'll include example manifests for SBOM, signature verification, and a tiny install playbook.

priya: I'll pull numbers from the offline price matrix and send a ballpark.

marcus-legal: I'll flag any export-controlled models and start the addendum draft.

annah-ops: I'll sketch the rollback steps + rollback script and host it in the runbook repo.

elaine: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll ping once the meeting is booked.
